title: Kakutani From Two-Player Nash Existence
body_html:
Kakutani From Two-Player Nash Existence

The existence of Nash equilibria for all finite two-player games implies Kakutani's fixed point theorem for upper semicontinuous compact-convex-valued correspondences on compact convex subsets of Euclidean space.

MFoGT Exercise 4.12.6 constructs finite two-player games from finite families of points $(x_i)$ and $(y_i)$, uses their Nash equilibria to generate approximate fixed points, and then takes an accumulation point to obtain a fixed point of the correspondence.
